description: This file defines the SearchFileInfoStore struct and its methods for managing file info search indexing, deletion, and search functionalities within the Mattermost server, specifically related to search engine integration and file indexing.

classes.name: SearchFileInfoStore
classes.description: Struct managing file info search indexing, deletion, and search operations, integrating with external search engines and the file info store.

methods.name: indexFile
methods.description: Indexes a file in all active search engines if indexing is enabled.

methods.name: deleteFileIndex
methods.description: Deletes a file from all active search engine indexes.

methods.name: deleteFileIndexForUser
methods.description: Removes all files associated with a user from search engine indexes.

methods.name: deleteFileIndexForPost
methods.description: Removes files associated with a post from search engine indexes (currently unused).

methods.name: deleteFileIndexBatch
methods.description: Deletes a batch of files from search engine indexes based on end time and limit.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves file info and indexes it.

methods.name: SetContent
methods.description: Sets content for a file and updates its index.

methods.name: AttachToPost
methods.description: Attaches a file to a post and updates its index.

methods.name: DeleteForPost
methods.description: Deletes files for a post and removes them from search indexes (temporary workaround).

methods.name: PermanentDeleteForPost
methods.description: Permanently deletes files for a post and removes them from search indexes.

methods.name: PermanentDelete
methods.description: Permanently deletes a specific file and removes it from search indexes.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteBatch
methods.description: Permanently deletes a batch of files based on end time and limit, updating search indexes accordingly.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes all files for a user and updates search indexes.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Performs a search for files across active search engines and falls back to database search if needed.
